# mtncloud_clusters (Data Source)

Lists your clusters, including those made in the console. A cluster is a managed group of hosts, for example a Kubernetes cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_clusters" "all" {}

output "clusters" {
  value = { for x in data.mtncloud_clusters.all.clusters : x.id => { name = x.name, name = x.name } }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cloud` (String) Only list clusters whose `cloud` is this (case ignored).
- `group` (String) Only list clusters whose `group` is this (case ignored).
- `layout` (String) Only list clusters whose `layout` is this (case ignored).
- `name_regex` (String) Only return clusters whose name matches this regular expression (RE2 syntax), for example `^web-`.
- `status` (String) Only list clusters whose `status` is this (case ignored).
- `type` (String) Only list clusters whose `type` is this (case ignored).

### Read-Only

- `clusters` (Attributes List) The clusters, sorted by name, then ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--clusters))

<a id="nestedatt--clusters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `clusters`

Read-Only:

- `cloud` (String) Cloud the cluster is in.
- `description` (String) Description, or empty.
- `group` (String) Group the cluster belongs to.
- `id` (Number) ID of the cluster.
- `layout` (String) Layout the cluster was built from, or empty.
- `name` (String) Name of the cluster.
- `status` (String) Status, or empty.
- `type` (String) Cluster type, for example `Kubernetes Cluster`.
